profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company, traded as DLR and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that describes itself as delivering the world's largest data center platform. According to its site, it offers data center services and colocation, with interconnection capabilities spanning data centers, connectivity, and cloud services across a global ecosystem. It says it serves deployments ranging from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and describes itself as sustainably built for flexibility, open ecosystems, and reach.

On AI, the company's site frames infrastructure as the constraint on adoption, pointing to inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It cites its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, which it says found that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and it describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 126.
